jamal: FYI — role-index v2 migration ran at 03:12 UTC and I saw a ~45s window where role_visibility rows were inconsistent. some devs briefly had `billing:read` on prod resources. i rolled the migration back and pinned previous index.
irene: ugh. any idea how that happened?
jamal: looks like the backfill job wrote role_visibility rows asynchronously, and concurrent auth checks read from the new index before the default role assignment backfill completed. race between `indexed_at` set and `defaults` backfill.
jamal: snippet of what backfill did:
```
-- simplified
INSERT INTO role_visibility (role_id, resource_id, permissions, indexed_at)
SELECT r.id, res.id, r.perms, now()
FROM roles r JOIN resources res ON res.org_id = r.org_id
WHERE r.created_at < now();
-- then separate job assigns defaults for legacy users
```
mar ia.s: FYI KMS checks also flaked during rollback window — key unwrap timed out for a tiny subset, so some audit events were not flushed immediately.
devsec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-045 — possible privilege escalation (low impact). Pager duty notified.
audit-bot: Missing audit events detected: 12 events between 2026-03-11T03:12:30Z and 2026-03-11T03:13:15Z. Query id: audit-logs-77b.
irene: :facepalm: ok. priority: patch migration to be idempotent + readable guard. also need to replay any missing audits to S3 and verify no external access occurred.
sam-platform: Suggested mitigations: 1) lock auth read path to old index until backfill txn completes OR 2) perform default role assignment in the same transaction/statement as the visibility insert, or 3) mark new index rows as `incomplete=true` and exclude from decision until completed. quick patch i can deploy:
```
BEGIN;
INSERT ... RETURNING id INTO temp_ids;
UPDATE role_visibility SET incomplete = false WHERE id IN (temp_ids);
COMMIT;
```
jamal: option 2 is preferable if SQL can do it in one tx. otherwise do option 3 quick.
maria.s: i'll also open KMS support ticket — looks like transient HSM slowness in region us-west-2 around that time.
irene: action items:
- jamal: create minimal migration patch (force-incomplete flag) and submit PR for emergency deploy (ETA 30m)
- sam-platform: stand by for hotfix deploy, add feature flag
- maria.s: KMS ticket + ensure audit replay to S3 (verify checksum)
- devsec-bot: create follow-up runbook for role-index migrations
- audit-bot: generate event dump and mark missing events as replayed

irene: also need a short postmortem doc (one-pager) after stabilizing. keep it focused: what happened, blast radius, timeline, fixes, follow-ups.
jamal: will post PR link once ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:
